question.text: The area of the region bounded by the curve $y=x^3$ its tangent at (1,1) and X-axis is

solution.text: We have, $y=x^{3}$ and $A(1,1)$ $\therefore$ $\frac{d y}{d x}=3 x^{2}$ On putting $x=1$ in $\mathrm{Eq}$. $\frac{d y}{d x}=3(1)^{2}=3$ $\therefore$ Equation of tangent at $A(1,1)$ is $y-1=3(x-1) \Rightarrow y=3 x-2$ $\therefore$ Required area $=\int_{0}^{1} x^{3} d x-\int_{2 / 3}^{1}(3 x-2) d x$ $=\left[\frac{x^{4}}{4}\right]_{0}^{1}-\left[\frac{3 x^{2}}{2}-2 x\right]_{2 / 3}^{1}$ $=\frac{1}{4}-\left[\left(\frac{3}{2}-2\right)-\left(\frac{2}{3}-\frac{4}{3}\right)\right]$ $=\frac{1}{12} \mathrm{sq}$ unit
